purpose: One 30-second Record trial of the exact early-grant candidate at100k; not indefinite reliability qualification
physical_setup: Previously confirmed: PA0 empty; board USB powered, ST-Link 3.3V disconnected; no wiring change requested
post_flash_replug: User board USB unplug/replug; ST-Link unchanged; app closed. Wait for actual ready reply.
diagnostic_metric_change: tx_max excludes prepare/encode; step/poll still include it. Never directly compare TX maxima with S8/S9 as total TX cost.
acceptance: Program verify and independent byte-equal readback of all37224 bytes
Exact build/CAPS before one START; target Record30 seconds after Preview; actual duration/overshoot and whole-command wall preserved
No source/host failure; record delta/host elapsed 90000..110000 samples/s is only a rough pacing check, not oscillator calibration
Normal END reason0 and matching STOP ACK; unknown produced tail retained, not zero
Fresh Open plus companion and exact selected raw compared to preserved wire, CRC/prefix/sequence validation
COM owner closed before any SWD; two legacy136 dumps equal, expected build/nonce/generation, frozen, flags0, poll and copy below5120us
TIM3 CEN0 PSC71 ARR9; ADC CR2=0 SMPR2 low3bits4; DMA EN0; relevant RCC clocks on/resets off; ADC_DR not read
Independent physical review against these unchanged acceptance criteria; a failed trial stays failed
failure_policy: Preserve all traffic, prefix and diagnostics; no automatic second START or changed-Fs retry

rollback_policy.retain_candidate_if: Boot/communication and stopped acquisition are confirmed, even if the stream trial failed
restore_only_if: Candidate fails to boot or communication remains unavailable after the planned USB replug
rollback_policy.recovery_target: Fresh complete SA snapshot, not automatic S4 rollback
rollback_policy.procedure: Record concrete reason; program fresh SA64KiB with verify, independent full readback equals snapshot, Reset/Run and user replug; SA-only READY helper without START
rollback_policy.working_S4_only_if: User needs ordinary verified50k or a separate concrete recovery need makes SA unsuitable
rollback_policy.user_instruction: Do not restore old firmware without necessity

trial_limit_notes.DWT_wrap_assumption: Check actual procedure wall/no debugger halt separately;30s target alone does not prove the whole procedure stays below59.65s. Do not infer elapsed seconds from rawDWT across wraps.
trial_limit_notes.audit_overhead: 13 bytes per nonempty chunk plus control traffic; no mathematical cap guarantee from assumed batch size. Audit overflow is host logging failure, not device queue-full.
trial_limit_notes.USB_early_grant_window: May age before a newly published transfer; no second reset; source throughput remains a hypothesis until this trial.

owner_close_gate: PASS requires owners_closed=true; FAIL requires cleanup_finished=true and final_state.phase=closed. No SWD before this gate.
